source: Schulz et al. 2020 independent Zenodo 4987060 MD5=69122a1d82b1fb970fb6638b02da3db4
question: Does Veronica decline × Plantago backup status add out-of-year predictive value for next-year local nonoccupancy conditional on current/previous host levels and butterfly abundance?
outcome: nest_count(t+1)==0 among nest_count(t)>0, same patch and consecutive t-1,t,t+1 years
processing: SimpleImputer(add_indicator=True, strategy=median) then StandardScaler then LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver=lbfgs,max_iter=1000); train-only preprocessing
validation: leave-one-calendar-year-t-out; paired heldout logloss and Brier baseline minus increment
uncertainty: 2000 fixed-seed cluster bootstraps of heldout paired loss differences by full patch and separately full year; independent egg counts not samples
criterion: Both patch and year bootstrap 95% lower bounds greater than zero, overall improvement positive and at least 12 of 18 years positive; otherwise FAIL predictive novelty gate.
confounding: observational association only; static hosts vs dynamic accessibility, spatial connectivity and parasitoids not fully controlled
prior_art: Schulz 2020 already reports two-host occupancy advantage; Opedal 2020 already reports extinction versus both host abundances.
